_comment: REAL ROBOT launch config for the operator console (vla_gui).
Lives at config/vla_gui.robot.json; vla_robot.sh and vla_demo.sh copy it into place.
NEVER edit $VLA_GUI_CONFIG (default ~/.vla_gui.json) directly; it is overwritten on every launch.
CONFIG FIX (reorg Phase 3): the SLAM and Nav2 buttons now use THIS REPOSITORY'S
hardware launch files, not the stock turtlebot4_navigation ones.
slam_hw.launch.py          remaps /parameter_events and /rosout off the Wi-Fi link
nav2_hw_composed.launch.py same remaps, bond_timeout 30 s, 20 s delayed STARTUP
The stock slam.launch.py and nav2.launch.py have NEITHER remap and a 4 s bond
timeout. Launching them floods the robot at ~7,400 packets/s (2 MB/s), the Pi
throttles at 84 C, camera frames stop and Nav2 aborts its own bring-up. That is
the 8 and 10 September failure, diagnosed on 11 September; captures are in
results/evidence/. These buttons were left pointing at the stock files and would
have recreated it on any fresh machine.
Every step sources config/robot.env rather than exporting a few variables by
hand. That is what gets fastdds_hw_wifi_only.xml (super client PLUS the
interface whitelist) instead of the older fastdds_super_client.xml, along with
the namespace and the compressed-transport settings. It matters because the GUI
passes its own environment to every child, so each step has to stand alone --
and after a machine rebuild there is no ~/.bashrc setting these.
The agent and voice steps now exec the same launchers the demo script uses
(tools/agent_xterm.sh, tools/voice_xterm.sh), so the hardware-only VLA_* flags
and the cuBLAS LD_LIBRARY_PATH fix are applied here too instead of being
duplicated and drifting.
STEPS 1 AND 2 ARE DISABLED: distrobox-host-exec returns exit 127 from inside
ubuntu22-gpu, so the GUI cannot reach the host or vla-box.
YOLO   (in vla-box): source $VLA_YOLO_ENV/bin/activate && python $VLA_SRC_DIR/yolo_server.py
Ollama (on host)   : ollama serve

steps.name: YOLO-World server (START BY HAND in vla-box)
Ollama Qwen2.5-7B (START BY HAND on host)
steps.cmd: if pgrep -x ollama >/dev/null; then echo '[ok] already running'; sleep infinity; else ollama serve; fi
